idea-plugin.name: Scalactive Single File Component (.st)
idea-plugin.description:
Language support for Scalactive single file components (.st).

  • <script lang="scala"> is highlighted as Scala, <style> as CSS.
  • In <template>, {{ expr }}, v-if / v-else-if / v-show / v-model / v-for, :attr and @event values are highlighted as Scala.
  • Component tags (starting with an uppercase letter) are highlighted separately.

Code completion, type errors, hover and go to definition for the Scala code in .st files are provided by the Scalactive language server (requires an IDE with LSP support and an sbt project that enables ScalactivePlugin; run sbt compile once so that target/scalactive-lsp.json is written).
